beats.label: 短步逼近
beats.detail: Briskly, the challenger advances 1.3 metres with weighted steps, brows drawn; the keeper tracks him calmly, pale robe turning without retreat.

beats.label: 斜劈试探
beats.detail: In a sudden burst the challenger cuts diagonally; the keeper raises a compact parry, eyes on the blade, sleeves snapping after the wrists.

beats.label: 触锋拨开
beats.detail: On blade contact at 2.0 seconds, the keeper turns the edge aside; a brief steel glint follows impact, the challenger recoil visibly checked.

beats.label: 收剑换线
beats.detail: At measured speed the challenger recoils half a step and shifts northwest, drawing his blade to his ribs; his sash swings then falls.

beats.label: 沉肩蓄杀
beats.detail: Slowly he sinks into a loaded stance screen left, jaw set; the keeper waits screen right, sword low, both feet grounded and blades apart.

beats.label: 单一机位
beats.detail: One continuous 240-degree orbit ends west of both fighters in a settled wide two-shot; no cut.

board.prompt:
Create ONE cinematic storyboard still, 16:9, premium painterly 3D Chinese wuxia animated feature, not a photo. Reference 1 = white keeper identity and clothing ONLY; reference 2 = teal challenger identity and clothing ONLY; reference 3 = courtyard architecture, materials and dusk palette ONLY, not its camera or exact staircase count. Exactly two adult men except when specified offscreen. One plain straight jian each, empty scabbards, no extra weapon. Same grey stone low dais, muted red flags, warm western rim light. No captions, text, panel layout or montage. Wide two-shot at the END of an orbit, camera west of the pair looking east, height 2.4m, 32mm. Teal challenger full body screen left, shoulders lowered, sword chambered by ribs, right foot back; white keeper full body screen right sword lowered. Clear 2.3m gap. Bell tower in distant left background, tree distant right; no blade contact. Frame the whole dais, no foreground pillar blocking fighters.
CRITICAL NEW CAMERA: This is a WEST-to-EAST view of the courtyard, a 90-degree change from reference 3. DO NOT put the northern temple entrance or its stairs in the center background. The north temple is OUT OF FRAME to the far LEFT. Center background is a LOW ruined EAST wall and mountains, bell tower far LEFT, big tree far RIGHT. Both fighters boots are ON TOP of ONE large circular dais, keeper exactly at its CENTER, challenger only 2.3m north of him. Frame the surrounding dais in front of both. Challenger right hand pulled BACK beside right ribs, blade aimed forward horizontally at the keeper, left foot forward, right foot back. His elbow is behind torso, not extended down. Camera 2.4m high looks slightly DOWN, wide two-shot.
Spatial correction takes priority over the environment reference composition. Preserve illustrated cinematic quality. Draw a fresh composition from the specified side.
